title: Trên, dưới, trong, ngoài, bên cạnh: location prepositions

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say to wake up —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dậy] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say to sleep —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngủ] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say breakfast —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ăn sáng] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say to invite —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rủ] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say free, or available —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rảnh] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say very —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rất] [EN: Good.]
